statement: Execution ledger for the T1E implementation. The T1D plan keeps its 44 historical NOT_EXECUTED rows; this ledger maps each of those cases and the Local corrections to the tests and commands that actually ran. Inputs precede expectations in every fixture. Synthetic content, schema and UI behaviour only; not live governance, store, identity or real non-coder UX evidence.

commands.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/lib/intent-spec-open-items.test.ts src/lib/intent-spec-legacy-golden.test.ts src/lib/intent-spec-review.test.ts src/lib/intent-spec-confirmation.test.ts src/lib/intent-spec-acceptance.test.ts src/components/IntentSpecReview.test.tsx
node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/lib/intent-spec-review-api.test.ts -t "saves exact confirmed content under the request actor|NIS T1E synthetic v2 save and reopen"

caseTotals.invocationNote: Cases map to tests many-to-many: some cases share one test, some tests use it.each, so 44 cases are not 44 test invocations. The tracked suites ran 143 invocations (140 focused plus 3 selected API) and one scratch invocation.

LD-1.evidence: Summary in review header and appendix only; SpecExport and the readiness helper are byte-identical; items-only update test AC-B7

LD-2.evidence: AC-L7 rewritten in the golden test: revision moves forward, acknowledgement is not restored, bytes compared at equal revision, acknowledgement, clock, reviewer and actor

LD-4.evidence: Concerns future tasks tracing; no tasks or plan artifact was built

LD-5.evidence: Nine item keys in order, own safe cited fields, bounded text and resolution and delegation length, explicit per-item reconfirm, overlapping user rules shown without a winner (open-items tests, review tests, acceptance AC-V4 rows)

LD-6.evidence: Local envelope blocks in governed copies

fixtureNotes.FX-A: Stage S0 holds only the conflict; S1 supplies U1 to U4 at the stage the user has them; no case demands an unknown earlier.
fixtureNotes.FX-B: A different job: cross-question conflict, a delegated item, a free unknown, two unknowns plus one conflict, zero-item control LG3. The conflict is fixture data, not a claim that identity requires login.

claimBoundary: Synthetic unit, component and portable-fixture results only. No AI inference, upstream code, provider, real operator store, identity, UAC, build, deploy or public effect. A passing run is not live AI governance, real non-coder UX or build readiness.
